title: Choose a default bean
summary: Spring Framework: Choose a default bean. Move @Primary to red.
introduction: @Primary marks the preferred bean when several beans match a type.
learningObjectives: Choose a default bean with Spring Framework

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Choose a default bean

blocks.text: Both factories return Strings, but @Primary tells a type-only lookup to prefer blue.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Only one matching bean should be the primary choice.
